question_variants: When was AKGEC established | AKGEC kab bana tha | college kab shuru hua tha | what is the establishment year of college
answer_en: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) was established in 1998, approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow.
answer_hi: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ki sthapna 1998 mein hui thi, jo AICTE se approved aur Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) se affiliated hai.

question_variants: Which courses and degrees are offered at AKGEC | kaun kaun se courses hain college mein | what programs are available at AKGEC | B.Tech M.Tech MCA available hai kya | degree courses offered
answer_en: AKGEC offers four-year B.Tech degrees across major engineering disciplines, two-year M.Tech in four specialisations, and a two-year Master of Computer Applications (MCA).
answer_hi: College mein sabhi pramukh branches mein 4 saal ka B.Tech, 4 branches mein 2 saal ka M.Tech, aur 2 saal ka MCA program chalaya jata hai.

question_variants: What is the sanctioned student intake capacity | college mein total kitni seats hain | B.Tech MCA intake kitna hai | how many seats are there in AKGEC
answer_en: The approved sanctioned intake is 1,320 seats for B.Tech, 120 seats for MCA, and 72 seats for M.Tech across four departments.
answer_hi: College mein B.Tech ke liye 1,320 seats, MCA ke liye 120 seats, aur M.Tech ke liye 72 seats sanctioned hain.

question_variants: Where is AKGEC located | college ka address kya hai | campus location and area | how to reach AKGEC campus
answer_en: AKGEC is situated at 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), P.O. Adhyatmik Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015.
answer_hi: AKGEC 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), P.O. Adhyatmik Nagar, Ghaziabad, UP 201015 par sthit hai.

question_variants: What are the administrative office hours | college office kab khulta aur band hota hai | helpdesk timings kya hain | when is the admin office open
answer_en: Academic classes and library facilities open at 8:30 AM on working days. Administrative offices are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, remaining closed on Sundays and official holidays.
answer_hi: Academic classes aur library subah 8:30 AM par khulti hain. Administrative offices Monday se Friday subah 9:00 se shaam 5:00 tak khule rehte hain.
source_title: AKGEC Central Library and Office Hours

question_variants: Who is the Director and Director General of the college | college ke director kaun hain | director ka naam kya hai | college leadership and director general
answer_en: Dr. Hemant Ahuja is the Director of AKGEC, and Dr. R.K. Agarwal is the Director General.
answer_hi: Dr. Hemant Ahuja AKGEC ke Director hain, aur Dr. R.K. Agarwal Director General hain.

question_variants: Which university is AKGEC affiliated with and what accreditations does it hold | AKTU affiliation code kya hai | is AKGEC approved by AICTE and NBA accredited | college recognition and affiliation
answer_en: AKGEC is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU, Lucknow) under College Code 027, approved by AICTE, with major B.Tech disciplines accredited by NBA.
answer_hi: AKGEC Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) se code 027 ke saath affiliated hai, AICTE se approved hai, aur pramukh B.Tech branches NBA accredited hain.

question_variants: How many books are in the central library | central library facilities kaisi hain | library mein kitni books hain | is the central library automated
answer_en: The central library is fully automated with over 1,00,000 books, national and international journals, and multimedia resources with smart RFID-card entrance access.
answer_hi: Central library poori tarah automated hai aur usmein 1,00,000 se zyada books, national/international journals, aur smart RFID access uplabdh hai.

question_variants: Does the library have digital e-resources and database access | DELNET and NDL access in library | digital library resources kya hain | online journals library mein available hain kya
answer_en: The library holds memberships of DELNET and the National Digital Library (NDL), and provides access to NPTEL, Coursera, edX, and IEEE e-resources.
answer_hi: Library ke paas DELNET aur National Digital Library ki membership hai, jismein NPTEL, Coursera, edX aur IEEE databases access kar sakte hain.

question_variants: Are previous year question papers available in the library | previous year question papers library mein milte hain kya | model solutions and sessional paper bank | PUT papers bank in central library
answer_en: Yes, the Central Library maintains a dedicated Question Papers and Model Solutions Bank containing previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), and university exam papers.
answer_hi: Central library mein previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), aur university exams ke question papers aur model solutions ka bank rakha jata hai.

question_variants: Are there departmental and hostel libraries on campus | hostel library hai kya | department library facility | how many departmental libraries exist
answer_en: The library system includes nine departmental libraries and five hostel libraries managed with resources on loan from the Central Library.
answer_hi: AKGEC library network mein Central Library ke alawa nau departmental libraries aur paanch hostel libraries shamil hain.

question_variants: Is the campus Wi-Fi enabled and what are the computing facilities | campus mein wifi hai kya | how many computers are in the college | internet speed and computer labs
answer_en: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed broadband networking over 1,400 computers across academic labs, departments, and hostels.
answer_hi: Campus poori tarah Wi-Fi enabled hai aur 1,400 se zyada computers broadband se connected hain.

question_variants: What Centres of Excellence and industrial training centres exist at AKGEC | robotics centre of excellence at AKGEC | industrial tie-up labs | kuka robotics siemens lab details
answer_en: AKGEC hosts 15+ industry-collaborated Centres of Excellence, including AKGEC-KUKA Industrial Robotics Training Centre, NI LabVIEW Academy, Siemens PLM, Bosch Rexroth Automation, and Janatics Pneumatics.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein 15 se zyada industry Centres of Excellence hain, jaise KUKA Robotics, NI LabVIEW, Siemens PLM, aur Bosch Rexroth.

question_variants: What is the AKGEC FabLab | fab lab facilities kya hain | 3D printing and digital fabrication lab | rapid prototyping equipment
answer_en: AKGEC FabLab is an MIT-affiliated digital fabrication facility equipped with 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC tools, and prototyping hardware for student projects.
answer_hi: AKGEC FabLab MIT affiliated digital fabrication lab hai jismein 3D printers, laser cutters, aur rapid prototyping tools available hain.

question_variants: What student technical societies operate at AKGEC | technical societies in college | Conatus CSI IEEE chapters kya hain | student coding clubs
answer_en: Active student technical societies include Conatus, Computer Society of India (CSI), IEEE Student Branch, SAE Collegiate Club, and Cloud Computing Cell.
answer_hi: College mein active technical societies Conatus, CSI student chapter, IEEE, SAE, aur Cloud Computing Cell hain.

question_variants: What cultural and literary societies are active on campus | cultural clubs at AKGEC | Oorja and Phoenix societies | extracurricular clubs on campus
answer_en: Campus cultural and creative societies include Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts and culture), Horizon (literary society), and Rotaract Club for community service.
answer_hi: Cultural activities ke liye Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts), Horizon (literature), aur Rotaract club chalaye jaate hain.

question_variants: What sports and gymnasium facilities are available on campus | sports facilities at AKGEC | gym and playground details | annual sports fest Spardha
answer_en: The college campus provides comprehensive indoor and outdoor sports facilities, along with well-equipped gymnasium facilities in hostel complexes.
answer_hi: Campus mein indoor aur outdoor sports ki suvidha hai, aur hostel complexes mein gymnasiums uplabdh hain.

question_variants: What is the campus placement track record of AKGEC | placements kaise hain AKGEC mein | top recruiting companies and placement statistics | campus placement offers
answer_en: AKGEC consistently records over 2,000 placement offers from 213+ visiting companies annually, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, and Capgemini.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein 2000 se zyada offers aur 213 se zyada recruiting companies aati hain jinmein TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, aur Capgemini shamil hain.

question_variants: What is the minimum attendance requirement for semester exams | attendance kitni chahiye exam ke liye | is 75 percent attendance mandatory | attendance criteria in college
answer_en: A minimum of 75% attendance across all scheduled lectures and practical sessions is strictly required by AKTU and college regulations to appear in end-semester examinations.
answer_hi: End-semester exams mein appear hone ke liye AKTU aur college norms ke mutabiq minimum 75% attendance hona anivarya hai.
source_title: AKGEC Academic Calendar & AKTU Attendance Ordinance

question_variants: What is the campus anti-ragging policy and student safety framework | is ragging banned on campus | anti ragging committee helpline | campus security and surveillance
answer_en: AKGEC enforces a strict zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy with 24x7 security, CCTV surveillance, and an Anti-Ragging Committee headed by Director Dr. Hemant Ahuja and Chief Proctor Prof. S.L. Kapoor (9312072348).
answer_hi: AKGEC mein anti-ragging policy sakti se lagu hai. College Director Dr. Hemant Ahuja aur Chief Proctor Prof. S.L. Kapoor (9312072348) ke netritva mein Anti-Ragging Committee karyarat hai.
source_title: AKGEC Online Reporting of Ragging Cases & Committee

question_variants: How can I take admission in B.Tech at AKGEC | B.Tech admission process kya hai | admission through UPTAC counselling | JEE Main rank se admission kaise hota hai
answer_en: B.Tech admissions are conducted primarily through Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) based on JEE Main merit ranks, alongside institutional quota seats per state norms.
answer_hi: B.Tech admission JEE Main rank ke aadhar par UPTAC counselling ke through aur institutional quota seats par state norms ke mutabiq hota hai.

question_variants: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission | B.Tech admission eligibility kya hai | 12th marks required for B.Tech | PCM percentage needed for engineering
answer_en: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects alongside Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science, securing minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST).
answer_hi: B.Tech ke liye candidate ko 10+2 mein Physics aur Mathematics ke saath minimum 45% marks (SC/ST ke liye 40%) prapt karna anivarya hai.

question_variants: Is there lateral entry admission to B.Tech 2nd year | lateral entry admission in B.Tech kaise hota hai | diploma holders admission in 2nd year | B.Sc lateral entry to engineering
answer_en: Candidates holding a 3-year Engineering Diploma or B.Sc degree with Mathematics are eligible for lateral entry admission directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) via UPTAC counselling.
answer_hi: 3-year Engineering Diploma ya Mathematics ke saath B.Sc pass candidates UPTAC lateral entry counselling ke through 2nd year mein direct admission le sakte hain.

question_variants: How can I take admission in MCA at AKGEC | MCA eligibility and admission process | CUET-PG for MCA admission | MCA admission criteria in college
answer_en: MCA admissions are based on CUET-PG scores. Eligibility requires BCA or graduation with Mathematics at 10+2 or degree level with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST).
answer_hi: MCA admission CUET-PG rank se hota hai. Candidate ke paas BCA ya graduation mein 50% marks (SC/ST 45%) aur Mathematics hona anivarya hai.

question_variants: How can I take admission in M.Tech at AKGEC | M.Tech eligibility and admission procedure | GATE score for M.Tech admission | M.Tech admission branches available
answer_en: M.Tech admissions require a B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST), evaluated through valid GATE scores or CUET-PG.
answer_hi: M.Tech ke liye relevant branch mein B.Tech (minimum 50% marks, SC/ST 45%) aur valid GATE ya CUET-PG score aavashyak hai.

question_variants: What meritorious scholarships are available for B.Tech and MCA | scholarship for JEE rank under 25000 | CUET rank scholarship for MCA | merit scholarship eligibility criteria
answer_en: Students with JEE Main AIR up to 25,000 for B.Tech, or CUET-PG AIR 1-750 for MCA, receive college merit scholarships, renewable upon maintaining 90% attendance and CGPA 7.5+ with no backlogs.
answer_hi: JEE Main AIR 25,000 tak ke B.Tech students aur CUET-PG AIR 1-750 ke MCA students ko merit scholarship milti hai, jo 90% attendance aur 7.5+ CGPA par renew hoti hai.

question_variants: Is there a tuition fee scholarship for M.Tech students | M.Tech scholarship for AKGEC alumni | fee concession in M.Tech course | M.Tech tuition waiver scheme
answer_en: M.Tech candidates securing 65% aggregate in B.Tech receive approx Rs 25,000 waiver, 70%+ receive 50% tuition waiver, and 75%+ receive 75% waiver, with a 5% relaxation for AKGEC alumni.
answer_hi: M.Tech mein B.Tech 65% marks par Rs 25,000, 70% par 50% tuition waiver, aur 75% par 75% waiver milta hai (alumni ko 5% aggregate chhoot).

question_variants: How can I apply for UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship | UP scholarship Samaj Kalyan form kaise bharein | scholarship form for SC ST OBC students | state government scholarship portal
answer_en: Eligible SC, ST, OBC, General, and EWS students can apply for the UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship via scholarship.up.gov.in and submit verified printouts to the College Registrar office.
answer_hi: Eligible students UP Government ke scholarship.up.gov.in portal par apply karke verified hard copies College Registrar office mein submit karein.
source_title: UP Government Scholarship Portal & Registrar Desk

question_variants: How can students pay the college fee | fee payment modes kya hain | fees online kaise bharein | can I pay fees by NEFT RTGS or Demand Draft | fee payment options at AKGEC
answer_en: Fees can be paid by Demand Draft or Pay Order in favour of Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College payable at Ghaziabad or Delhi, by online transfer through NEFT/RTGS, or via the Kotak Mahindra Bank online fee payment portal.
answer_hi: Fees Demand Draft/Pay Order se, NEFT/RTGS online transfer se, ya Kotak Mahindra Bank ke online fee portal se jama ki ja sakti hai.

question_variants: What details should be written on the demand draft for fee payment | DD ke peeche kya likhna hota hai | submitting demand draft for fee | DD payment instructions for students
answer_en: Write the student's name and mobile number on the reverse of the draft. It may be submitted in person or sent by post to Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, Ghaziabad.
answer_hi: Draft ke peeche apna naam aur mobile number likhein. Ise college aakar ya post ke dwara jama kiya ja sakta hai.

question_variants: Is the counselling amount adjusted in college fees | counselling deposit fees mein adjust hoga kya | UPTAC counselling fee adjustment | counselling fee deduction from total fee
answer_en: Yes, the full seat acceptance fee deposited during UPTAC counselling is credited and deducted from the candidate's total first-year college fee.
answer_hi: Haan, UPTAC counselling ke samay jama ki gayi seat acceptance fee total first-year college fee mein se ghata di jaati hai.

question_variants: Is the caution money refundable and how much is it | caution money kab wapas milti hai | caution money refund process | security deposit refund policy
answer_en: The caution money of Rs 5,000 paid at admission is a refundable security deposit, returned to the student upon course completion and submission of the no-dues clearance.
answer_hi: Admission ke samay li gayi 5,000 rupaye ki caution money course complete hone aur no-dues clearance ke baad refundable hoti hai.

question_variants: What benefits are covered under medical charges in the fee | medical insurance cover in college fee | medical charge mein kya facilities milti hain | hospitalization and accident insurance coverage
answer_en: Annual medical charges cover hospitalisation insurance up to Rs 50,000, personal accident insurance up to Rs 1,00,000, and free annual OPD consultations at Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: Medical charges mein 50,000 rupaye tak ka hospitalization insurance, 1,00,000 tak ka accidental cover, aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital mein free annual OPD checkup shamil hai.

question_variants: Do students pay university exam fee to AKGEC or AKTU | exam fee kisko pay karni hoti hai | university exam fee submission process | digital library university fee payment
answer_en: The university examination fee of Rs 7,500 and digital library fee of Rs 700 to Rs 1,000 are paid directly by students to the university as and when demanded.
answer_hi: Examination fee Rs 7,500 aur digital library fee Rs 700 se 1,000 seedhe university ko tab dein jab university maange.

question_variants: Where can I get the fee receipt after payment | fee receipt kaise download karein | payment receipt for education loan or tax | ERP fee receipt generation
answer_en: Fee receipts are generated digitally on the college ERP portal under Fee Payment within one working day of payment clearance, suitable for tax and education loan claims.
answer_hi: Fee receipts payment clearance ke baad ek working day mein college ERP portal par Fee Payment section se download ki ja sakti hain.

question_variants: Can the college fee structure change during the course | fee structure badal sakta hai kya | is the college fee fixed for 4 years | state fee fixation committee guidelines
answer_en: The fee structure is subject to revision as determined periodically by the Uttar Pradesh State Government Fee Fixation Committee for private engineering institutions.
answer_hi: College fee structure UP State Government Fee Fixation Committee dwara badla ja sakta hai.

question_variants: When are AKTU semester end examinations conducted | semester exam kab hote hain | odd and even semester exam dates | end semester exam schedule in AKTU
answer_en: Odd semester theory examinations are typically conducted in December-January, and even semester examinations in May-June, as notified on the official AKTU academic calendar.
answer_hi: Odd semester ke exams December-January mein aur even semester ke exams May-June mein AKTU calendar ke anusaar hote hain.
source_title: AKGEC Academic Calendar & AKTU Exam Schedule

question_variants: What are internal sessional tests and PUT examinations | sessional exam kab hote hain | Pre-University Test PUT kya hota hai | internal assessment exams schedule
answer_en: The college conducts two internal sessional exams and one comprehensive Pre-University Test (PUT) per semester to evaluate continuous internal assessment marks.
answer_hi: Continuous internal assessment ke liye har semester do sessional tests aur ek Pre-University Test (PUT) karwaya jata hai.

question_variants: Where and when can students download their exam admit card | admit card kab milega | where to get admit card | hall ticket download for semester exams
answer_en: Admit cards are published on the AKTU ERP student portal approximately three days prior to the commencement of the first theory examination.
answer_hi: Admit card pehle theory exam se lagbhag teen din pehle AKTU ERP portal par download ke liye uplabdh hota hai.

question_variants: Where is the examination seating plan displayed | seating plan kaise dekhe | exam room kaise pata karein | hall seating arrangement on exam day
answer_en: The daily exam seating plan is displayed on notice boards of respective academic blocks and published on the college ERP portal one day before each exam.
answer_hi: Exam room aur seating plan har block ke notice board aur ERP portal par exam se ek din pehle lagaya jata hai.

question_variants: How can a student apply for answer sheet re-evaluation or scrutiny | re-evaluation form kaise bharein | scrutiny process for exam results | challenging evaluation in AKTU
answer_en: Students can apply for challenge evaluation or scrutiny online through the AKTU ERP portal within 7 to 15 days of result declaration upon paying the prescribed university fee.
answer_hi: Result aane ke 7 se 15 din ke andar AKTU ERP portal par prescribed fee ke saath challenge evaluation ya scrutiny ke liye apply kar sakte hain.
source_title: AKTU ERP Challenge Evaluation & Scrutiny Portal

question_variants: What are the rules for back paper and carry-over examinations | back paper kab de sakte hain | carry over examination rules kya hain | how to clear backlog papers
answer_en: Carry-over examinations (back papers) for odd semesters are held alongside regular odd semester exams, and even semester carry-overs alongside regular even semester exams.
answer_hi: Odd semester ki back paper odd semester exams ke saath aur even semester ki carry-over even semester exams ke saath di ja sakti hai.

question_variants: How do graduating students collect provisional degree and final transcript | provisional degree kaise milti hai | final degree collection process | migration certificate and transcript issuance
answer_en: Provisional degree certificates and consolidated grade cards are issued by the College Registrar office after final semester result clearance and submission of the no-dues slip.
answer_hi: Provisional degree aur marksheet final result clearance aur no-dues slip submit karne ke baad College Registrar office se milti hai.
source_title: AKGEC Issuance of Certificates for Passout Students

question_variants: How many hostels are on campus and what is the total capacity | kitne hostel hain college mein | hostel capacity and accommodation details | boys and girls hostel numbers
answer_en: The college provides six hostels spread over four complexes: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, and Girls Complex, accommodating over 1,500 students.
answer_hi: College mein 6 hostels hain jo 4 complexes mein hain: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, aur Girls complex, jinmein 1,500 se zyada students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: Where do first year boys stay | junior boys hostel details | first year hostel separate hai kya | 1st year hostel accommodation
answer_en: First-year boys stay in the dedicated Junior Boys Hostel complex in double occupancy rooms, ensuring a secure and ragging-free environment.
answer_hi: First-year boys Junior Boys Hostel complex mein double-seater rooms mein rehte hain jo bilkul ragging-free aur secure environment deta hai.

question_variants: What are the accommodation facilities for girls | girls hostel rooms kaise hain | girls hostel occupancy and capacity | female student accommodation in college
answer_en: Female students are accommodated across three secure girls' hostels featuring double and triple seater rooms with an intake of approximately 600 students.
answer_hi: Chhatraon ke liye teen surakshit girls hostels hain jinmein double aur triple seater rooms hain aur lagbhag 600 students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: Is hot water and Wi-Fi available in hostels | garam paani milta hai kya hostel mein | solar water heater in hostel | hostel amenities gym and internet
answer_en: All campus hostels are equipped with eco-friendly solar water heating systems, Wi-Fi internet facility, a TV room, a library with reading books, and a gymnasium.
answer_hi: Sabhi campus hostels mein solar water heating system, Wi-Fi internet, TV room, reading books wali library, aur gymnasium uplabdh hai.

question_variants: Does the college provide bus service and which routes are covered | college bus service routes kya hain | bus facility Delhi Noida Ghaziabad | transport facility routes for day scholars
answer_en: AKGEC runs a fleet of college buses covering extensive routes across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Anand Vihar, and Dilshad Garden for day scholars.
answer_hi: AKGEC Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, aur Anand Vihar ke sabhi mukhya routes par college bus service chalata hai.

question_variants: How can students apply for a bus pass and pay transport fees | bus pass kaise banta hai | bus pass fee payment process | transport pass registration procedure
answer_en: Students apply for bus passes through the Transport Coordinator desk by submitting the route registration form and paying transport fees for the semester or academic year.
answer_hi: Bus pass lene ke liye Transport Coordinator desk par route registration form submit karke semester ya annual transport fee bharein.
source_title: AKGEC Transport Desk & Online Fee Portal

question_variants: What medical emergency and ambulance facilities are on campus | medical emergency on campus facility | ambulance service in college | campus dispensary and doctor on call
answer_en: AKGEC maintains an on-campus medical dispensary with visiting medical officers, nursing staff, and a dedicated 24x7 ambulance tied to Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: AKGEC campus mein doctor aur nursing staff ke saath dispensary hai aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital se connected 24x7 ambulance seva uplabdh hai.

question_variants: What is the emergency helpline and security protocol | security helpline number on campus | emergency contact at AKGEC | security guard control room contact
answer_en: For immediate campus emergencies, contact Chief Administrative Officer Mr. Satender Singh (9911220320) or the 24x7 Main Gate Security Control Room via EPABX 8744052891, or dial national emergency 112.
answer_hi: Campus emergency ke liye Chief Administrative Officer Mr. Satender Singh (9911220320) ya Main Gate Security (8744052891) par call karein ya 112 dial karein.
